Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add Vercel config and merge BYO image overrides

- Add vercel.json and api/index.ts for Vercel deployment option
- Merge and consolidate product image overrides
- Add missing Valentine BYO item mappings \(valentine-oreo-pucks-2, valentine-brownie variants\)
- Use correct mini-tin-*.jpg images for mini cakes

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix broken images and convert MySQL scripts to PostgreSQL

- Add name-based fallbacks for cookie images in productImages.ts
- Add BYO base box image overrides
- Filter Valentine''s category to only show tier products \(not BYO items\)
- Convert all .mjs scripts from MySQL to PostgreSQL/Neon compatibility

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

EOF
\)")
